mapper.sql: select s.id, s.merchant_id, s.product_id, s.service_name, s.service_image, case when s.product_id is not null then p.price else s.service_price end as service_price, case when s.product_id is not null then p.original_price else s.service_price end as original_price, s.description, case when s.product_id is not null then p.stock else s.stock end as stock, s.status, s.sort, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.remark, s.del_flag from mall_booking_service s left join product p on p.id = s.product_id and p.merchant_id = s.merchant_id
mapper.select: where s.product_id = #{productId} and s.del_flag = '0' order by s.status desc, s.sort asc, s.id asc limit 1

and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = 1 and ( s.product_id is null or (p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = '0') ) and s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and s.service_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by s.sort asc, s.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_booking_service ( merchant_id, product_id, service_name, service_image, service_price, description, stock, status, sort, create_time, update_time, remark, del_flag ) select p.merchant_id, p.id, p.name, p.cover_image, p.price, p.description, p.stock, 1, p.sort, now(), now(), '由上架商品自动生成预点单服务', '0' from product p where p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = '0' and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and not exists ( select 1 from mall_booking_service s where s.product_id = p.id and s.del_flag = '0' )
mapper.select:
select coalesce(bit_xor(crc32(concat_ws('|', id, merchant_id, product_id, service_name, service_image, service_price, description, stock, status, sort, remark, del_flag, coalesce(update_time, create_time)))), 0) from mall_booking_service s
and s.del_flag = '0' and s.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
